name: Property Walkthrough
description: Field notes for real-estate property walkthroughs: unit/system condition, capital needs, rents and numbers, and a verdict.

sections.title: Property Snapshot
sections.instruction: Address or identifying details, property type, unit count, and who attended the walkthrough.

sections.title: Overall Impression
sections.instruction: One paragraph honest assessment of the property's condition and curb appeal.

sections.title: Condition by Area
sections.instruction: Condition notes organized by area or system (roof, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, foundation, units, common areas, parking). Flag anything that looked original, damaged, or life-safety. Always add reference transcript segment and timestamp.
sections.item_format:
| Area / System | Condition | Est. Concern Level | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Capital Needs
sections.instruction: Estimated capital expenditures discussed: item, rough cost if mentioned, urgency.

sections.title: Numbers
sections.instruction: Rents, occupancy, taxes, insurance, utilities, asking price, and any deal math discussed (cap rate, cash-on-cash, price per unit). Always add reference transcript segment and timestamp.
sections.item_format:
| Figure | Value | Context | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

sections.title: Neighborhood & Comps
sections.instruction: Observations about the area, comparable properties, or rental demand mentioned.

sections.title: Verdict & Next Steps
sections.instruction: The verdict expressed (pursue / pass / needs more info), conditions attached, and follow-up actions with owners. Always add reference transcript segment and timestamp.
sections.item_format:
| Verdict / Action | **Owner** | When | Reference Transcript Segment | Segment Time stamp |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
